finding.observed_source_behavior: The billed create payload and campaign fingerprint bind Full training, SFT method, n_checkpoints, random_seed, learning_rate and warmup_ratio, but the post-create retrieve verifier only compared files, model, epochs/evals and random_seed.
finding.risk: A provider-returned job whose create-relevant training mode or hyperparameters differ could be labeled created_job_identity=VERIFIED by the local verifier.
finding.provider_contract_basis: Current Together fine-tuning job retrieve/create documentation exposes training_type, training_method, n_checkpoints, learning_rate and warmup_ratio as job metadata, so these values are available for fail-closed post-create verification.

unusual_experiment.hypothesis: The current verifier rejects a provider-returned job if create-relevant Full-FT identity fields are substituted after billed create.
unusual_experiment.counterhypothesis: Because those fields are absent from expected, a substituted LoRA/training hyperparameter metadata object is accepted as identity-equivalent.
unusual_experiment.intervention: Against the exact vulnerable verifier semantics, preserve all compared fields while substituting training_type=LoRA, learning_rate=9e-4, warmup_ratio=0.4, n_checkpoints=0 and an unrelated output name.
unusual_experiment.note: This is one bundled identity-substitution intervention, not multiple unusual experiments. Subsequent per-field tests are deterministic regressions.

repair.mechanism: Use one expected_created_job_identity contract and recursively normalize provider SDK model/dict values before exact comparison. Post-create verification now includes n_checkpoints, learning_rate, warmup_ratio, training_method and training_type in addition to the prior files/model/epochs/evals/seed fields.
repair.fail_closed: Missing or substituted create-relevant provider metadata becomes JOB_CREATED_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; the already-created job remains JOB_KNOWN and must be reconciled rather than replaced blindly.
